description: openEMS: the C44 stub via backdrilled from the bottom, 1.2 mm deep, drill 0.5, default stackup JLC061611-3313A with masks
case: C44, exit on L3, backdrilled (examples.md example 5 "backdrill")

structure.frame: first barrel at x = y = 0 (the pair's second at y = 0); z up from the outer face of L6's copper

via.barrel: solid PEC cylinder of the drill diameter from z = 0 to 1.637

backdrill.what: air from below the bottom mask to z = depth: barrel, pads and mask removed

domain.note: planes, laminate and masks run into the PML on the four sides

openems.interface: Python 3.14 wheels of the release, venv C:\Users\Jonat\opt\openEMS-venv
openems.engine: default (multithreaded), material averaging on, lossless here

mesh.pml: 8-cell PML inside the domain on every open side
mesh.notes: x, y: at most 0.0500 (6 cells per drill) over the via block (pads, antipads, returns, backdrill), graded 1.3 to 0.15; a line within 15 um of a more important one left out (sym_lines merge); y: thirds rule at the feed edges (0.01 inside, 0.02 outside); z: lines on every copper and dielectric face and on the masks over copper, 4 cells in the 0.092 prepregs, at most 0.05 in the board, graded to 0.2 in the air; every axis mirror-symmetric about the structure's centre (x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.8185); no line on the mask over laminate (4.5 um from the copper face; material averaging)
mesh.barrels: staircase (openEMS default, no conformal option): 6 cells per drill, lines on the drill edges; pads, antipads, return vias and the backdrill on lines at their edges where they cross the axes, staircased elsewhere

excitation.source: openEMS LumpedPort (R 50 ohm, soft E source in its edges), one run per excited port

ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = -4.5, y = 0; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)
lumped port R 50 ohm at x = 4.5, y = 0; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

stub.how: from S at the reference planes (feeds included); the de-embedded S21 removes both feeds with their own Z and beta (to the via axis) and is referred to 50 ohm

tdr.time: round trip, 0 = 50 % of the edge at the reference plane

sParameters.how: one run per port, S = B A^-1 at every frequency (common.fit_s): the full 2-port
sParameters.referencePlanes: the ports' x below (3 mm feeds included, not de-embedded)

feeds.how: each probe plane's Z = sqrt(E dE / (H dH)) and beta (from the run where its signal is largest)

sanity.feedsVs2DNote: the 2D solver (lines.ts) on the trapezoid (base 0.1377, top 0.11992) with its mask; openEMS has the rectangle of the mean width; bars |dz| <= 4 % (openEMS reads the feeds about 3.4 % high on this mesh, 27 um cells across the trace by the thirds rule; msl-c39 at 15 um read 1.45 % low), |deeff| <= 3 %
sanity.model: examples.md example 5 (quasi-static model): at 10 GHz S21 -0.07 dB, S11 -18.1 dB

provenance.postProcessedAgain: from the same run's probe files (--post): S, lines and sanity re-made by the scripts named
